messages:
Rina (sales): Quick help — MediCore POC failing when they enable stream + function_call + json_schema. UI shows 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Non-streaming OK.
Rina (sales): They open 6 concurrent streams in the dashboard. Fail starts after a spike.
infra-bot: rate_limit for acct-medicoresandbox at 1964999995 - burst=310 limit=300 - returning 429s.
Omar (eng): Likely two things: 429s aborting the stream mid-object and our stream chunking splitting a tool_call JSON across deltas so client parses too early.
Jess (solutions): Short-term ask: 1) reduce frontend concurrency to 3-4, 2) add a client buffer and only JSON.parse when finish_reason or a small metadata final=true event is seen, 3) fallback: retry with stream=false on parse failure.
Rina (sales): Can we temporarily raise their burst cap so the demo isn't blocked?
infra-bot: Increased acct-medicoresandbox burst cap to 600 for 24h at 1965000020. Verbose tenant streaming logs enabled.
Omar (eng): We'll add a tolerant assembler that emits completed JSON objects only when fully assembled. Filing INF-3620 for the runtime fix.
QA-Tom: INF-3620 created and assigned. Repro plan: parallel streams >5 + simulated 429 mid-stream.
Rina (sales): Sent mitigation steps and fallback snippet to MediCore. They reduced concurrency and the demos worked. Keeping INF-3620 open. Thanks everyone! :tada:
